Description: Five incommensurate wave directions interfere into decagonal quasicrystal bands: ordered, non-repeating, and hypnotically unstable under time evolution.
KScript: var q := t*v0+u*v1; var d0 := v2*x+q; var d1 := v2*(x*cos(pi*0.2)+y*sin(pi*0.2))+q*1.13; var d2 := v2*(x*cos(pi*0.4)+y*sin(pi*0.4))+q*0.87; var d3 := v2*(x*cos(pi*0.6)+y*sin(pi*0.6))+q*1.29; var d4 := v2*(x*cos(pi*0.8)+y*sin(pi*0.8))+q*0.71; var field := sin(d0)+sin(d1)+sin(d2)+sin(d3)+sin(d4); var envelope := cos(t*v5+u*v1); z += field*v3*envelope; sx := sx*(1.0+abs(field)*v4); sy := sy*(1.0+abs(field)*v4); sz := sz*(1.0+abs(field)*v4); rx += cos(d0)*v6; ry += sin(d2)*v6;
